messages:
kate: Folks, quick follow-up from Cygnus postmortem. Recap: repeated isolation during on-prem maint windows caused by ACL churn + intermittent BGP reset. Customer saw three flaps in 45 days. Need owners for remediation, short timelines, and a recurring-detection policy.

josh: TL;DR from me: automation allowed blanket ACL removes without a peer-safety check. Also our healthcheck didn't surface asymmetric routing fast enough.

marta: I'll own the runbook + onprem preflight checklist. Will add explicit commands and a go/no-go checkbox for ACL changes. Target 2026-04-11.

eng-ops-bot: Created ticket INC-4380 and attached postmortem doc: https://tracker.example.com/INC-4380 :ticket:

josh: I'll take the automation guard change to block ACL removals that touch active peer ranges and add a staged canary mode. ETA 2026-04-07.

pm-ryan: Please include a short customer-facing note template in the ticket. I'll send the follow-up once we have the runbook+guard dates.

marta: Runbook items I'll add: (1) preflight: `show ip bgp summary`, `iptables -t nat -L -n`, (2) confirm peer CIDR presence, (3) schedule within customer's maintenance window, (4) notify AM + oncall.

josh: For healthchecks, plan is to extend probe to check forward+reverse path and fail fast if path asymmetry detected. Also add a test harness sim to reproduce BGP reset locally. ETA 2026-04-15 for PR + tests.

kate: Also proposing a monitoring label `peering-repeat:cycle` and a rule: if a customer has >=3 peering incidents in 60 days, auto-add to account-risk and schedule a platform review. Can someone add that to INC-4380?

eng-ops-bot: Label `peering-repeat:cycle` added to INC-4380.

marta: I'll add an entry to the chronic-issues dashboard linking Cygnus and tags.

josh: Deploy plan: automation-guard v2.0 -> staging 2026-04-05 04:00 UTC, prod 2026-04-07 02:00 UTC. I'll include rollback steps.

kate: Recap owners/dates: marta (runbook) 2026-04-11, josh (automation guard + tests) 2026-04-07/2026-04-15, ryan (customer comms after artifacts ready). React with :white_check_mark: if you accept.

marta: :white_check_mark:

josh: :white_check_mark: opening PRs this week

pm-ryan: :white_check_mark: will draft note after runbook lands

kate: Thanks team. Will track progress in INC-4380 and circle back on the account review if we see additional flaps.
